meta.title: Bakvion — Automatic, encrypted backups for Windows
meta.description: Bakvion backs up your business files every day to your own external disk or Google Drive. Set up in about 2 minutes.

hero.lead: Bakvion backs up your business files every day — to your own external disk or your Google Drive. Set it up once in about 2 minutes, then forget about it.

steps.title: Ready in about 2 minutes
steps.subtitle: No technical knowledge needed. Three steps and your files are safe.
steps.s1Text: Download Bakvion and run the installer. It sets everything up for you.
steps.s2Text: Sign in with the details you received, or tap “Connect with Bakvion experts” and we'll set you up.
steps.s3Text: Pick your folders, pick your disk or Google Drive, and choose when to back up. Done.

features.title: Everything a small business needs
features.f1Text: Runs on your schedule in the background, even when the app is closed.
features.f2Text: Every backup is locked with strong encryption before it is saved.
features.f3Text: Get back any file or folder from any day, in a few clicks.
features.f4Text: Know after every backup whether it worked — or what to fix.

where.title: Your backups stay with you
where.subtitle: Bakvion saves your files only to places you own. We never see or store your data.

install.title: Installing: one quick note
install.subtitle: Windows may show a blue “Windows protected your PC” screen the first time. This is normal for new software.
install.step3: Follow the installer — it takes under a minute

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: How do I get an account?
faq.a1: Fill in “Talk to a Bakvion expert” here or in the app. We create your account and send you your sign-in details on WhatsApp.
faq.a2: Yes. Backups keep running offline. Bakvion syncs your membership whenever you're back online.
faq.q3: What happens if my membership ends?
faq.a3: New backups pause, but you can always restore everything you already backed up.

final.title: Protect your files today
final.subtitle: Download Bakvion, open it, and you're a few clicks away from automatic backups.

plans.title: Backup plans
plans.subtitle: What gets backed up and where it goes.
plans.queued: Backup started. It keeps running even if you close this window.
plans.testOk: The destination is writable and readable.
plans.initBody: Bakvion creates a new encrypted backup store here, with a key protected on this PC. Existing stores are never overwritten.
plans.initOk: Destination set up. Save your recovery kit from Settings, then run a backup.
plans.verifyOk: All backup data in this destination checked and correct.
plans.emptyBody: Create your first plan to protect files on this PC.
plans.connectBody: Use this on a new PC. Enter this destination's key from your recovery kit.
plans.connectOk: Backup connected. You can restore from it now.
plans.restoreOnlyHint: Opened from another PC. You can restore from it; to back up this PC, create a new plan.
plans.deleteBody: Scheduled backups for this plan stop and it is removed from this PC. Backups already saved stay on the disk; you can open them again with your recovery kit (Restore → Open a backup from another PC).
plans.deleteKit: Save your recovery kit first: it holds the key for these backups.
plans.deleteOk: Plan deleted. Its backups are still on the disk.

wizard.title: Create a backup plan
wizard.name: Plan name
wizard.exclusions: Skip these files (one pattern per line)
wizard.fileLevel: Bakvion backs up files and folders. It does not create full system images.
wizard.destHint: Choose an external disk, another drive or a folder, or use Google Drive.
wizard.storeHint: A “BakvionRepository” folder is created there when you set it up.
wizard.reviewNote: After saving, set up each destination, then run your first backup.
wizard.scheduleHint: If the PC is off at that time, the backup runs once as soon as it is back on.
wizard.cleanupHint: The newest backup is always kept. When off, every version is kept.
wizard.keyNote: Bakvion creates a secure encryption key for each destination. After setting up, save your recovery kit from Settings.
wizard.driveIntro: Bakvion saves the encrypted backup in your Google Drive folder on this PC, and Google Drive for desktop uploads it.
wizard.driveStep1: Install Google Drive for desktop (google.com/drive/download) and sign in.
wizard.driveStep2: Open Google Drive settings (gear icon) → Preferences → Google Drive.
wizard.driveStep3: Choose “Mirror files” and click Save. Wait until “My Drive” appears in your user folder.
wizard.driveStep4: Come back here and click “Check again”.
wizard.driveNote: Mirror mode also keeps a copy on this PC, so the C: drive needs free space. Backups reach Google only after Drive finishes uploading.
wizard.driveStream: Google Drive is set to “Stream files”. Bakvion works in the background and cannot use a streamed drive. Switch to “Mirror files” (steps 2 and 3).
wizard.driveNotFound: No Google Drive folder found on this PC yet.

restore.title: Restore
restore.subtitle: Get back any file or folder from any backup.
restore.emptyBody: Backups are read straight from your disk — no internet needed.
restore.safeBody: Files are restored into a new folder and checked before they appear. Nothing existing is overwritten.
restore.limit: Showing up to 500 matching items. Search to narrow the list.
restore.done: Restore finished: {n} files checked and saved to {target}
restore.openOther: Open a backup from another PC
restore.openBody: Use this on a new PC. Choose the backup folder (on the external disk or in Google Drive) and enter the key from your recovery kit.
restore.openOk: Backup opened. Choose it above to restore files.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every backup run for every destination (latest 200).
history.emptyBody: Backups appear here after they run.
history.noShadow: Open files may have been skipped (no Windows snapshot)
history.unreadable: Some files could not be read

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, appearance and this PC.
settings.signOutBody: Backups on this PC stop until you sign in again. Your backups and settings stay on this PC.
settings.serviceBody: Bakvion keeps backing up in the background even when this window is closed.
settings.keysBody: Your encryption keys are protected on this PC. Save the recovery kit on a pen drive or another safe place, away from the backup disk. You need it to restore on another PC.
settings.kitNeeded: New keys were created. Save your recovery kit now.
settings.reportsBody: Get an email after backups run: what was saved, what failed and how to fix it. Hourly plans send one summary a day.
settings.reportsTestSent: Test email sent to {emails}. Check the inbox and the spam folder.
settings.reportsHint: Reports are sent when this PC is online. If it is offline, they are sent as soon as it reconnects.
settings.aboutBody: Bakvion updates itself in the background. Use these numbers to check this PC has the latest version.
settings.updateAvailable: Version {v} is available. It installs automatically when no backup is running.
settings.installing: Installing version {v}. The app will close; open it again in a minute.
settings.devBuild: Development build: automatic updates are off.
settings.mismatch: The app and the background service have different versions. Restart the PC to finish the update.
settings.updOffline: No internet connection. Updates will be checked when this PC is online.
settings.updBusy: A backup is running; the update will install when it finishes.
